query: SELECT st.*, tm.name as memberName, tm.role as memberRole, tm.type as memberType, s.name as spvName FROM spv_team st LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON st.memberId = tm.id LEFT JOIN spvs s ON st.spvId = s.id LIMIT 20;
